selection_disclosure: User approved this revision after viewing the six-objective front and metric-ablation results. Precision choices are economic display judgments, not blind preregistration or statistical significance. No target front size is specified.

metrics.name: cagr
metrics.reason: Net annual return at the original 10bp one-way cost; 0.1 percentage point equals 1000 yuan annualized per 1 million yuan capital.

metrics.name: drawdown_magnitude
metrics.reason: Peak-to-trough loss; 0.01 percentage point equals 100 yuan per 1 million yuan peak equity. This is decision granularity, not an uncertainty bound.

metrics.name: fee20_cagr
metrics.reason: Net annual return at double one-way cost, read from same-source full-account evaluation. Captures achieved stress outcome rather than rewarding a smaller loss from a lower baseline. Report correlation and omission sensitivity versus standard return.

grouping: Same standard-scenario behavior_id only; rank configurations first, retain every member, layer, source identity, parameter differences and pressure-scenario range/missingness. No general cross-scenario equivalence claim.
representative_policy: Researcher describes observed core-front return/drawdown tradeoffs and retains the previous representative as a continuity comparison. Within identical observed outcomes, use documented nearest-neighbor diagnostics only as a provisional comparison, not a robustness certificate or automatic tie-break score. No fixed quota or automatic nomination.

resources.reason: Small deterministic reranking of 36 rows; no new Optuna search or CPU-intensive account evaluation.

unmeasured: Order queue, impact, capacity and latency
